animal in profile with distinct head

justification: Both surfaces show low-relief, rather schematic figures set out as a horizontal band of repeated forms, and both combine animals in profile with a small anthropomorphic figure whose limbs and raised arms are indicated in a similarly stubby, rounded manner. But the depicted content differs: A is a stacked, multi-register composition dominated by large bird- and quadruped-headed creatures plus a net/zigzag pattern band, while B is a single continuous frieze of human-like figures with arms raised flanking a large hunched animal, an interaction scene that has no counterpart in A.
